What meeting agenda, seated capacities, layouts, breakouts, confidentiality, internet and hybrid/AV specifications are required?
What budget and package inclusions are expected, including private dining, transfers, excursions, wellness and accessibility or dietary requirements?
Does contracting occur through the DMC, an overseas incentive agency or the end client? What commission/net-rate, payment, cancellation and attrition terms apply?

Offer a brief product call or site inspection and a current fact sheet. First have the resort confirm meeting capacities/AV, group inventory rules, trade terms and inclusions. Request a real brief before quoting: client/programme, dates, rooms, meeting format and decision process. Do not claim an existing partnership or confirmed booking, or use the June 2026 promotional deadline as a current offer.

The published Grenada roles establish useful contacts, not dedicated corporate-incentive ownership; reconfirm present responsibilities and the legacy individual email.

The official team page names Marielle Alexander, Chanelle Phillip and Wistell Bowen in Grenada roles; the contact page names Marielle as the Grenada contact.
The official contact page provides both a Grenada office route and a separate Incentives & Conferences inbox/telephone.
Spice Island Beach Resort’s official accommodation page states 64 luxury villa-style suites; its website identifies the property as all-inclusive on Grand Anse Beach.
An April 2026 external announcement reports two redesigned corporate meeting venues, but their specifications were not independently confirmed on the official resort pages reviewed.
uncertainties: No named current Grenada corporate client, live programme, confirmed destination booking or travel dates were found; destination marketing is not proof of a scheduled event.
No actual guestroom, meeting, catering or activity requirements were established for this account; room nights, budget and revenue cannot be quantified.
No individual hotel-sourcing, purchasing, budget-approval or contract-signing authority was explicitly verified.
No existing preferred-supplier agreement, commission arrangement, procurement portal or Spice Island Beach Resort relationship was established.
The published Grenada roles establish useful contacts, not dedicated corporate-incentive ownership; reconfirm present responsibilities and the legacy individual email.
The reported 50- and 12-person meeting capacities and AV specifications need written resort confirmation. A separate hyphenated-domain meetings page was not treated as the official hotel website.
The external 2026 announcement’s June 30 booking promotion has passed as of 3 November 2026; no extension was established.

recommended_next_step.title: Recommended next step
recommended_next_step.body: Pursue as a qualified-fit DMC relationship, not a live event lead. Send a short, personalized trade introduction to Marielle via the current Grenada office route, copying the published incentives inbox: reference their own small high-end Grenada retreat positioning, introduce Spice Island Beach Resort’s 64-suite luxury all-inclusive offer, and ask who owns hotel sourcing for Grenada corporate groups. Offer a brief product call or site inspection and a current fact sheet. First have the resort confirm meeting capacities/AV, group inventory rules, trade terms and inclusions. Request a real brief before quoting: client/programme, dates, rooms, meeting format and decision process. Do not claim an existing partnership or confirmed booking, or use the June 2026 promotional deadline as a current offer.
qualificationQuestions: Who owns Grenada incentive and corporate-retreat enquiries, and who recommends hotels, negotiates rates, approves spend and signs the accommodation contract?
Is there an active client programme or only destination development? What is the programme identity, client sector and decision timetable?
What arrival/departure dates, alternate dates, delegate/companion count, rooming mix, peak rooms and length of stay are required?
What meeting agenda, seated capacities, layouts, breakouts, confidentiality, internet and hybrid/AV specifications are required?
